profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Visionist
profile.summary: I love solving hard problems. I have 10 years of analysis experience with 5 of those years building my software solution skills. I thrive in multi disciplinary problem sets, and have a track record of learning fast and brining impactful results. Bring me onboard to solve your toughest problems.

positions.title: Discovery Analyst
positions.description: Develops and maintains digital signal processing software tools. Worked on building and releasing WVT 5. Added new features and capabilities not present in previous versions. Authored Concept of Operations for a task and management tool built for the academic environment to model real world tools and practices in the defense industry.

positions.title: 32d Intelligence Squadron Commander's Program Manager/Section Chief/Deputy Flight Chief
positions.locationName: Fort George G. Meade, Maryland, United States
positions.description:
• Maintained 3 programs and 7 project managers, providing status updates to the commander weekly
• Oversaw the arrival of 150 inbound members, ensured they were received, properly in-processed; cutting out of access time in half.
• Managed and employed 110 out of access personnel waiting for their clearance to process so they can begin the mission of the 32d
• Introduced new products and ideas to the Commander’s Support Staff to streamline or automate processes, saving hundreds of work hours
• Fixed multiple living documents that were incorrect for decades

positions.title: Senior Signals Analyst Supervisor
positions.locationName: Fort George G. Meade, Maryland, United States
positions.description:
• Created tools, processes, and techniques used throughout the NSA.
• Filled GS-14 position for 6 months, led 9-member team with 120+ years of combined experience
• Worked as peers with those holding masters and doctorates degrees
• Designed training methods, concepts, and courses used globally
• Single handedly solved 5 cryptologic problems that eluded the intelligence community for multiple years within a 2-week period
• Named #2 Signals Analyst in the United States Air Force 2019 and earned Technician of the Year 2017 and 2020

positions.title: Senior Signals Analyst
positions.locationName: Lackland Air Force Base, Texas, United States
positions.description:
• Managed the operations and analysis of 30 members
• Primary technical advisor to senior leadership
• Established a new mission, boosted site reporting and successes 30%
• Named analyst subject-matter expert, identified as part of the top 10% of signals analyst in the United States Air Force, earned multiple site awards, and a letter of appreciation from the Director of the NSA

educations.schoolName: Community College of the Air Force
